reviews.title: Cmon son
reviews.text:
I DID NOT PAY FOR THIS APP JUST TO HAVE CHILDISH NONSENSE FLOOD A PLATFORM THAT SHOULD BE BUILT FOR SERIOUS ANGLERS. This is supposed to be a place for people who share a passion for fishing—not a playground for kids to mess around on.

I’m clearly not the only angler who feels this way, and the frustration is justified. If this is the experience we’re paying for, then the app should’ve been FREE from the start.

Paying users deserve quality, accountability, and an experience that respects the fishing community. We’re here to fish, learn, share knowledge, and connect with other anglers—not pay for something that fails to deliver what it promises.

LISTEN TO YOUR USERS. RESPECT YOUR ANGLERS. FIX THE PROBLEM. Because without the people who support this app, there is no community and no business.

reviews.title: Pay wall Death spiral
reviews.text: The free version is officially dead, and the paid version is too expensive. Free data is essentially no longer going to be uploaded if the only free feature is uploading the data for paid users…lol. $80 is too steep for non professionals, and professionals don’t necessarily need this app. Garmin has better maps anyway. It’s already too late now that the popularity of the app is gone but cheaper pricing (or less corporate greed should I say) would’ve kept them afloat much longer but it’s too late. In response: offering multiple tiers, or purchasing each option separately can be an option, that’s a lame excuse.

I don’t have connectivity issues at all because everything else works on my phone  with no issues. So I asked customer support, I got connected with an agent through the text chat and finally was able to tell them what was going on and even sent them screenshots. After my explanation I never got a response. I just want to be able to see where I should be fishing this weekend for Labor Day but I guess I’m doing it the old fashion way and just cast a line and see how it goes. This is my first review I’ve ever done for an app. Since I was totally disregarded by support I’ll most likely cancel my membership and try and find an app that actually cares about its customers. When the app use to work it worked perfect but having no customer support is ridiculous. If I could attach screen shots of them not responding to me I would.

reviews.title: Poorly designed map
reviews.text:
Whoever designed this app clearly never uses it themselves. Whenever I try to zoom in or out, the map always thinks I’m trying to ping a place on the map. It was so frustrating that it made me delete this app. 

Terrible user experience. I shouldn’t have to fight with the app to zoom into a place. The entire point of this app is to find places to fish, which takes a lot of map manipulation. If the app constantly thinks I’m trying to ping something, then I cannot see what it is that I’m trying to do. 

And on top of that, the paywall is awful. Im so sick of apps constantly trying to take pennies from its users. Im fairly certain if I paid for this app, the problems I have with this user experience would probably go away. But that itself makes me never want to pay a cent to this company. The creators of this app couldn’t care less about anyone fishing. I would be willing to bet that the people in charge of this app or project have never even casted a fishing lure before.

reviews.title: Would Easily Be 5 Stars Without This
reviews.text:
I would absolutely change this review if they fixed this because the app itself is actually beautifully made and very easy to use. The design, maps, and overall layout are great. But one of the biggest problems is how they lock basic features behind a paywall. You can click on a lake and only view a few pictures before they try forcing you to pay just to see more catches. That’s ridiculous. Looking at pictures people post should not require a subscription.

A much better premium feature would be charging people to see the exact catch location or coordinates instead of blocking simple photos. I honestly think one of the biggest reasons this app hasn’t blown up even more is because they charge users just to browse pictures and enjoy the community side of fishing.

reviews.title: Loved this app until recently
reviews.text: For the past 2+ years I’ve had this app I loved it and used it every time I went out fishing. I traveled for work to many states and used it without a problem until recently…. You used to be able to see catches at a body of water but now that’s hidden behind a subscription package. I understand exact catch locations being behind the sub package and that never bothered me. But I can’t even look at pictures like before. It seems like yall got really money hungry. And before I get a reply saying “it takes a lot to maintain” or whatever, yall did it before with a lot less users. I think if it went back to the way it was before a lot more people would use it. I used to tell everybody about this app and to install it but not anymore. I was even a part of the beta crew since I really wanted to see this app progress into something great but that’s just not the case anymore…

reviews.title: Annoying
reviews.text: Don’t get me wrong when I first got fish brain I was so happy, I could look at a bunch of different things to help me catch fish depending on location, weather, time of day, etc. But recently Fishbrain has been making you pay a subscription for very little things. For example I can’t even go to a specific body of water near where I live and see what people have caught. I have to pay a monthly subscription for that and many other things. This app was really nice early on but as time has moved onward the company behind Fishbrain has grown very very money hungry. I will say this though, if you are willing to pay this app monthly it is great and one of the best apps out there for fishing. But other than that I do not recommend.

reviews.title: Ok this will be long but please hear me out
reviews.text: I seriously can’t stand how Fishbrain puts a paywall on practically every useful feature—it feels less like a fishing app and more like a constant sales pitch. Every time I try to check something genuinely helpful, I’m hit with another prompt to upgrade, which completely kills the flow and fun of using it. Instead of feeling excited to log catches or explore places i feel like they are just not letting me. I understand COMPLETELY that yall need money to keep your business going. Every business needs money to keep it running it's just how it is. BUT! there is no need to spend a ridiculously high fee to acquire and use the most important and most needed asset and utilities that most people downloaded the app for only for them to find out about the paywall fee needed to access the features that they downloaded the app for. the entire app is almost virtually unusable unless you have the pro upgrade. So please. if anything at least lower the price
